subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should `/usage tokens` and `/usage full` render provider quota windows only from a lifecycle-owned cached snapshot, or should the product permit a bounded credentialed provider fetch during each reply?
rationale: This choice determines reply latency, credential use, quota polling frequency, and the stable meaning of the existing usage modes; source evidence shows the current status and reply-footer paths are deliberately separate.

options.title: Render a prepared snapshot
options.body: Add a generic cached/provider-owned usage snapshot and append its shared summary when present, omitting quota text when unavailable.

options.title: Allow bounded reply-time loading
options.body: Permit a hard-timeout best-effort provider lookup per enabled footer while explicitly accepting its latency and provider-polling cost.

options.title: Keep quota in `/status`
options.body: Retain the current on-demand status surface and decline per-response quota rendering to keep reply output and runtime work unchanged.

recommendation.title: Render a prepared snapshot
recommendation.body: Add a generic cached/provider-owned usage snapshot and append its shared summary when present, omitting quota text when unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: The related provider-usage/status history and prior issue scoping make this the strongest available routing candidate.
